$comment: Production record, 29 Aug 2026, UNMODIFIED, and DELIBERATELY NOT ACCEPTED. Bare field names but every counter is a STRING ("176"), plus rx_type_arol and no timespan. Passes the envelope, so Input returns 200 and publishes; fails the lorastats payload schema, so the Writer dead-letters it. That is the decision in ADR-007 §4: encode one dialect and make the disagreement visible in the DLQ rather than absorb it into a permissive union. It carries version:1, same as the canonical dialect, so nothing on the record could have discriminated it. NOTE: production sends tenant == maintenant == "mzc", which is exactly the trap in claude/CLAUDE.md §6. This fixture is kept byte-faithful because its job is to be a production regression guard; it is NOT an isolation test. The *-tenant-isolation-pair.json fixtures, where the two values deliberately differ, remain the only isolation guards.
